summaryEn: Official full event unveiling the Tesla Semi truck and the new Roadster.
summaryZh: 正式完整发布Tesla Semi卡车和新款Roadster的活动。

segments.textEn: I'm the leader of the truck program here at Tesla, and it's my great pleasure to welcome you here in Los Angeles.
segments.textZh: 我是Tesla这里的卡车项目负责人，我非常荣幸地欢迎各位来到洛杉矶。

segments.textEn: All of you. All of you have played a very important role in making this event possible and ensuring the success of Tesla. Many of you here have given lots of referrals for the sales. Thank you very much.
segments.textZh: 你们所有人。你们所有人都为促成这场活动并确保Tesla取得成功发挥了非常重要的作用。在座的许多人为销售提供了大量转介绍。非常感谢。

segments.textEn: Many of you over there have helped us on the Trek program, have given us feedback, have given us a lot of advice, and have placed a lot of reservations for the Trek. So thank you very much for your support.
segments.textZh: 你们那边有很多人帮助了我们的 Trek 项目，向我们提供了反馈，给了我们很多建议，还为 Trek 下了很多预订。所以非常感谢你们的支持。

segments.textEn: And finally, I want to thank all of our employees here in Los Angeles, in the Bay Area and at the Gigafactory for all their hard work for something.
segments.textZh: 最后，我要感谢我们在洛杉矶、旧金山湾区以及超级工厂的所有员工，感谢他们为了某件事所付出的全部辛勤努力。

segments.textEn: We make a lot of sacrifices, but I think you will agree with me that it's worth it when you see those beautiful products. I'm personally very passionate about trucks. I've been lucky to work in that industry for a long time. And I'm proud to say that we have the best trucks ever.
segments.textZh: 我们作出了很多牺牲，但我想，当你们看到那些漂亮的产品时，你们会同意我的看法，认为这一切都是值得的。我个人对卡车非常有热情。我很幸运，能在那个行业工作很长时间。而且我很自豪地说，我们拥有有史以来最好的卡车。

segments.textEn: Are you ready to see them?
segments.textZh: 你们准备好见到它们了吗？

segments.textEn: Bring them on.
segments.textZh: 把它们开上来。

segments.textEn: Want to give the trucks a moment? Give the trucks a moment.
segments.textZh: 想给这些卡车一点时间吗？给这些卡车一点时间。

segments.textEn: All right.
segments.textZh: 好了。

segments.textEn: All right. Welcome, welcome, welcome to the, to the welcome to the Tesla Semi Truck event. I hope you like what you see.
segments.textZh: 好了。欢迎，欢迎，欢迎来到，来到这个，欢迎来到 Tesla Semi 卡车发布会。希望你们喜欢眼前所见。

segments.textEn: I'm going to tell you about everything that this truck can do. It blows my mind. I think it'll blow yours. Starting with performance. So an acronym we came up with that I think really describes the performance. Well, Technical term, but let's show you what that means in acceleration. So one thing that we care about, Tesla, is we really care about performance. We want a vehicle that feels incredible, that accelerates like nothing else.
segments.textZh: 我要向你们介绍这辆卡车能做的一切。它让我大为震撼。我想它也会让你们大为震撼。先从性能说起。所以，我们想出了一个缩写，我认为它确实描述了这种性能。好吧，这是个技术术语，但让我们通过加速来看看它是什么意思。所以，Tesla 真正在意的一件事是，我们真的非常在意性能。我们想要一辆感觉不可思议、加速表现无与伦比的车。

segments.textEn: Let's show what the truck. What it's like to be in a Tesla truck. This is real time.
segments.textZh: 让我们展示一下卡车。坐在 Tesla 卡车里是什么感觉。这是实时画面。

segments.textEn: So that's the Tesla. The Tesla Semi will go 0 to 60 in five seconds.
segments.textZh: 这就是 Tesla。Tesla Semi 从 0 加速到 60 英里/小时只需 5 秒。

segments.textEn: That's by itself or with a trailer. Now, at £80,000 max gross vehicle weight, that's the most amount of weight you can carry on a US Highway. This is the real time acceleration of a Tesla semi. That on the left, the thing that looks like it's not moving is a diesel truck.
segments.textZh: 这是卡车单独行驶或挂着拖车时的表现。现在，在最大车辆总重为 £80,000 时，这是在美国公路上所能承载的最大重量。这就是 Tesla Semi 的实时加速表现。左边那个看起来像是没在动的东西是一辆柴油卡车。

segments.textEn: Give it a moment.
segments.textZh: 给它一点时间。

segments.textEn: I'm sorry to bore you. I apologize.
segments.textZh: 抱歉让你们觉得无聊。我道歉。

segments.textEn: Boring. I know.
segments.textZh: 很无聊。我知道。

segments.textEn: Eventually it'll get there. All right, even with £80,000 pulling max gross, getting 60 miles an hour in 20 seconds, that's what it can do. Now, what about up a hill?
segments.textZh: 它最终会到那里的。好了，即使拖着 £80,000 的最大总重，它也能在 20 秒内达到每小时 60 英里，这就是它能做到的。现在，上坡时又怎么样？

segments.textEn: Okay, the best diesel trucks can only do 45 miles an hour. Up a 5% grade Tesla Semi can do 65 miles an hour up to 5% grade, That's 65 miles an hour continuous at max gross.
segments.textZh: 好，最好的柴油卡车只能达到每小时 45 英里。在 5% 的坡度上，Tesla Semi 能以每小时 65 英里的速度爬上最高 5% 的坡度，也就是在最大总重下持续保持每小时 65 英里。

segments.textEn: What this means is that if you've got, if you're pulling a load over the Rockies or some mountainous terrain up a hill, you're earning per mile, you're earning 50% more per mile than you are in a diesel truck. That's a gigantic difference.
segments.textZh: 这意味着，如果你正，如果你拖着货物翻越落基山脉，或者在某种山地地形上爬坡，你是按英里赚钱的，那么你每英里赚的钱会比驾驶柴油卡车多 50%。这是一个巨大的差别。

segments.textEn: Now one of the biggest questions we've been asked about electric trucks is, well, how far can they go? Because, well, let's find out. So, 500 mile range.
segments.textZh: 现在，人们向我们提出的关于电动卡车的最大问题之一是，嗯，它们能跑多远？因为，嗯，让我们来看看。所以，续航里程为 500 英里。

segments.textEn: But what does a 500 mile range mean? And by the way, it's 500 miles at maximum weight at highway speed. So you're doing like 60 miles an hour.
segments.textZh: 但 500 英里的续航里程意味着什么？顺便说一下，这是在最大重量下以公路速度行驶 500 英里。所以你的速度大概是每小时 60 英里。

segments.textEn: That's a worst case scenario. But what it means is that since because the vast majority of routes, because the vast majority are under 250 miles, it means that you can go to your destination and back. Even if your destination has no charging, you can go there and back, go there at home without recharging. So you can deliver a load out to the middle of nowhere and come back.
segments.textZh: 这是最糟糕的情况。但它意味着，因为绝大多数路线，因为绝大多数都不到 250 英里，所以你可以到达目的地再返回。即使你的目的地没有充电设施，你也可以去那里再回来，去那里，在家，不用充电。所以你可以把货物运到荒无人烟的地方，然后再回来。

segments.textEn: Now how do we achieve this? One of the ways we do this is we designed the Tesla truck to be like. So whereas a normal diesel truck is designed more like a barn wall, this is a bullet. You can see this in the drag coefficient. So the Tesla Semi has a 0.36 drag coefficient. This is a really good number.
segments.textZh: 那么我们是如何做到这一点的？我们采用的方法之一，是把 Tesla 卡车设计成像。普通柴油卡车的设计更像一面谷仓墙，而这是一颗子弹。你可以从风阻系数中看出这一点。Tesla Semi 的风阻系数为 0.36。这是一个非常出色的数字。

segments.textEn: As by way of comparison, a Bugatti Chiron, which is a 2 million dollar supercar, has a 0.38 drag coefficients. This has got a better drag coefficient than a supercar.
segments.textZh: 作为比较，一辆价值 200 万美元的超级跑车布加迪 Chiron，风阻系数为 0.38。它的风阻系数比超级跑车还要好。

segments.textEn: And by the way, we, yeah, by the way, you can see that in the design, the probably we achieve that is with the bullet shaped nose. We also have side flaps that map to the whatever trail you're pulling, whether it's a new trailer or old trailer, the side flaps will map to whatever trail you're pulling and close the gap. So this, this makes a huge difference to the drag coefficient. The bottom of the truck is also completely flat, so the air can flow straight through.
segments.textZh: 顺便说一下，我们，没错，顺便说一下，你们可以从设计中看出来，我们做到这一点的可能方式是采用子弹形车头。我们还有侧翼，可以贴合你所牵引的任何路径，无论是新拖车还是旧拖车，侧翼都会贴合你所牵引的任何路径，并封闭间隙。所以这，这对风阻系数有着巨大的影响。卡车底部也完全平坦，因此空气可以直接流过。

segments.textEn: These are things that you don't see on any other trucks. And it gives us incredible highway range. One of the key factors, we also have four independent motors. There's a motor on each of the rear wheels and an independent front suspension. So it's incredibly comfortable to drive this truck.
segments.textZh: 这些都是你在其他任何卡车上看不到的设计。而且它让我们获得了不可思议的公路续航里程。其中一个关键因素是，我们还配备了 4 台独立电机。每个后轮上都有一台电机，并且配备独立前悬架。所以驾驶这辆卡车极其舒适。

segments.textEn: Yeah.
segments.textZh: 是的。

segments.textEn: And then we just for interest sake, we created a pickup truck version of the Tesla semi.
segments.textZh: 然后，纯粹是出于兴趣，我们打造了一个 Tesla Semi 的皮卡版本。

segments.textEn: It's a pickup truck that can carry a pickup truck.
segments.textZh: 这是一辆能装载一辆皮卡的皮卡。

segments.textEn: By the way, this is, you can Legally drive that. It shouldn't be legal, but you will actually be able to legally drive that with a normal driver's license. It's kind of wrong, but I like it.
segments.textZh: 顺便说一下，这个，你可以合法驾驶它。这不应该合法，但你实际上可以用普通驾驶执照合法驾驶它。这有点不对劲，但我喜欢。

segments.textZh: 现在，驾驶员体验怎么样？驾驶这辆卡车是什么感觉？

segments.textEn: That's amazing because this truck has no gears. It's, there's no, you're not constantly shifting gears. It has one, one gear. So it's, it's, it's smooth. It's like driving, it's like driving a Tesla. It's as though you're driving a Model S or Model X or Model 3. It's just big. It's really, it's super easy to drive and it feels incredibly responsive, unlike any truck that you've ever driven.
segments.textZh: 这太棒了，因为这辆卡车没有多个挡位。它，没有，你不需要不断换挡。它只有1个，1个挡位。所以它，它，它很平顺。就像驾驶，就像驾驶一辆 Tesla。就好像你驾驶的是 Model S、Model X 或 Model 3。只是它很大。它真的，它超级容易驾驶，而且感觉响应极其灵敏，与你开过的任何卡车都不一样。

segments.textEn: And the point of view that you have is also incredible. We put the driver in the center, so the driver is actually in the center of the truck. You're positioned like you're in a race car.
segments.textZh: 而且你拥有的视野也令人难以置信。我们把驾驶员安排在中央，所以驾驶员实际上位于卡车的中央。你所处的位置就像在赛车里一样。

segments.textEn: You have complete visibility of the road and all the surroundings.
segments.textZh: 你可以完整地看到道路和周围的一切。

segments.textEn: It's a beautiful, spacious interior. You can stand up inside. It's got redundant screens and it's, it just feels incredible to drive this. It's one of the best feelings. It's so. It's incomparably better than another, than any other truck on the road. You really have to drive it to understand just how good that feels. Like I can drive this thing and I have no idea how to drive this. Am I?
segments.textZh: 内饰漂亮又宽敞。你可以在里面站起来。它配有冗余屏幕，而且，驾驶它的感觉就是不可思议。这是最棒的感受之一。它太。它比另一辆，比道路上的任何其他卡车都好得无可比拟。你真的必须亲自驾驶，才能明白那种感觉究竟有多好。就像我能驾驶这东西，可我根本不知道该怎么驾驶这个。我是吗？

segments.textEn: Just gives you a sense. By the way, we'll say like.
segments.textZh: 只是让你有个概念。顺便说一下，我们会说，比如。

segments.textZh: 另外，前面还有一个小行李厢。好吧，我们也把这个加进去。

segments.textEn: As compared to.
segments.textZh: 相比之下。

segments.textEn: I don't want to hurt your eyes, but that's what a diesel truck looks like today. It's a clutter of third party devices. It's very difficult to use. It requires integration, installation. These things don't talk to each other. It's a pain in the neck. It has significant add on costs. Whereas the Tesla semi, all of this is included. It's included in every truck. Everything just works.
segments.textZh: 我不想伤害你们的眼睛，但如今的柴油卡车就是这个样子。里面杂乱地堆着第三方设备。使用起来非常困难。它需要集成、安装。这些东西彼此不通信。非常麻烦。它还有高昂的附加成本。而 Tesla Semi 则包含这一切。每辆卡车都包含这些。一切都能直接使用。

segments.textEn: The moment you get the truck, it's got everything.
segments.textZh: 你拿到卡车的那一刻，它什么都有了。

segments.textEn: And as soon as they integrate with all the fleet systems, the things that are really important to the trucking industry. So what about fueling today? If you're fueling a diesel truck, you've got fumes, spills, toxic environment, prices change all the time. And what a lot of people don't realize is it actually, it takes up to 15 minutes or more to actually fill a truck. You have to sit there for 15 minutes while the tank gets filled.
segments.textZh: 而且它们一与所有车队系统集成，那些对卡车运输业真正重要的东西。那么如今加油是什么样的？如果你在给柴油卡车加油，就会有油气、泄漏、有毒环境，价格还一直变化。而很多人没有意识到的是，实际上，给一辆卡车加满油最多需要15分钟或更长时间。油箱加油时，你必须在那里待上15分钟。

segments.textEn: As compared to charging a Tesla truck, you can charge at your origin or destination. So while you're unloading your cargo, you can charge.
segments.textZh: 相比之下，给 Tesla 卡车充电时，你可以在出发地或目的地充电。所以卸货的时候，你就可以充电。

segments.textEn: So the reason 400 miles is important is because you have to take take a break eventually. So if you drive for, if you drive for five or six hours, which is that's about as much as you want to be driving continuously because you have to stop for bathroom break, get a bite to eat, in fact, you're legally required to stop for 30 minutes. So but you, if 400 miles is like six plus six to seven hours of driving, which means, what this means in practice is that by the time you are, you're done with your break, the truck is ready to go, you will not be waiting for your truck to charge.
segments.textZh: 所以400英里之所以重要，是因为你最终必须休息。所以，如果你驾驶，如果你驾驶5或6个小时，这差不多就是你愿意连续驾驶的最长时间，因为你必须停下来上厕所、吃点东西，事实上，法律要求你必须停车休息30分钟。所以但是你，如果400英里大约相当于6个多小时，6到7个小时的驾驶时间，这意味着，实际上这意味着，等到你，你结束休息时，卡车已经准备好出发了，你不必等卡车充电。

segments.textEn: It's a big deal.
segments.textZh: 这意义重大。

segments.textEn: And because of the Tesla mega chargers that will be installing Wallet, just like we've got superchargers installed worldwide, you've seen the supercharger map. It started off with just a few, with just a few chargers in California. Now we have superchargers throughout the world. And you'll be able to go anywhere with a Tesla consumer vehicle. The same will be true of the Tesla semi. You'll be able to travel anywhere in the world on the Tesla mega charger network.
segments.textZh: 而且，由于将会安装 Wallet 的 Tesla Megacharger，就像我们已经在全球安装了超级充电站一样，你们都看过超级充电站地图。它一开始只有少数几个，只有加利福尼亚州的少数几个充电站。现在我们在世界各地都有超级充电站。驾驶 Tesla 乘用车，你将能够去任何地方。Tesla Semi 也会如此。你将能够借助 Tesla Megacharger 网络前往世界上的任何地方。

segments.textEn: And that means we can guarantee the electricity rates because these will be solar powered mega charges that charge to a Tesla power pack is 24,7 guaranteed low electricity.
segments.textZh: 这意味着我们可以保证电价，因为这些将是由太阳能供电、为 Tesla Powerpack 充电的 Mega charges，是 24,7 保证的低价电力。

segments.textEn: And because these mega charges are solar powered, your truck is running on sunlight. Okay, What about safety? Now when I say safety, I'm talking about the driver safety. I'm also talking about other cars on the road. I'm talking about pedestrians. Safety for everyone.
segments.textZh: 而且因为这些大型充电设备由太阳能供电，你的卡车就是靠阳光行驶。好了，安全性呢？现在我说安全性时，我谈的是驾驶员的安全。我也在谈道路上其他车辆的安全。我说的是行人。每个人的安全。

segments.textEn: If you've got £80,000 moving at 60 miles an hour, it's a very dangerous thing. Every truck we sell will have enhanced autopilot as standard. Okay.
segments.textZh: 如果有 £80,000 的东西以每小时 60 英里的速度移动，那是非常危险的。我们售出的每辆卡车都会把增强版自动辅助驾驶作为标准配置。好了。

segments.textEn: The truck will automatically break.
segments.textZh: 卡车会自动坏掉。

segments.textEn: Yeah, you can read it too.
segments.textZh: 对，你也能读出来。

segments.textEn: It'll automatically break, but it will actually automatically lane keep as well. So even if, even if, even if you're in the truck and you have a medical emergency, the truck will stay in lane and gradually come to a halt and put on the emergencies. If it doesn't hear a response from you will actually call emergency services and get an ambulance. It's going to take care of you, it's going to take care of other cars, it's going to take care of pedestrians.
segments.textZh: 它会自动坏掉，但实际上也会自动保持车道。所以即使，即使，即使你在卡车里突发医疗状况，卡车也会保持在车道内并逐渐停下来，然后打开危险警示灯。如果它没有听到你的回应，实际上会呼叫紧急服务并叫一辆救护车。它会照顾你，会照顾其他车辆，也会照顾行人。

segments.textEn: This is a massive increase in safety.
segments.textZh: 这是安全性的巨大提升。

segments.textEn: A few other things about safety. It's got with that central position, you're in a very safe position. Even if you were to collide with another semi, you have a low center of gravity that gives you really good handling. Means the probability of a rollover is massively reduced because the battery pack is in the floor pan and rollover risk is dramatically reduced. And perhaps most importantly, jackknifing is usually the worst nightmare of a trucker.
segments.textZh: 关于安全性还有其他几件事。由于采用那个中央位置，你处在一个非常安全的位置。即使你要与另一辆半挂卡车相撞，你也拥有较低的重心，从而带来非常好的操控性。这意味着侧翻的概率大幅降低，因为电池组位于底板中，侧翻风险显著降低。或许最重要的是，折刀现象通常是卡车司机最可怕的噩梦。

segments.textEn: How do you stop your vehicle from jackknifing if you're in difficult conditions, the truck will automatically stop jackknifing because it's got independent motors on each wheel and it'll dynamically adjust the torque on each wheel so that jackknifing is impossible.
segments.textZh: 如果你身处恶劣条件，如何阻止车辆发生折刀现象？卡车会自动阻止折刀现象，因为每个车轮上都有独立电机，而且它会动态调节每个车轮的扭矩，从而使折刀现象变得不可能。

segments.textEn: Your worst nightmare is gone with this truck. Gone. Never have to worry about it.
segments.textZh: 有了这辆卡车，你最可怕的噩梦就消失了。消失了。再也不用担心它。

segments.textEn: Miserable job.
segments.textZh: 悲惨的工作。

segments.textEn: Reliability.
segments.textZh: 可靠性。

segments.textEn: Reliability is incredibly important. Truck is your life. It's your business. Truck breaks down, you're disappointing your customers. It's a horrible day. It could be a horrible week. It could break down in the middle of nowhere. That's safety issues.
segments.textZh: 可靠性极其重要。卡车就是你的生活。它是你的生意。卡车坏了，你就会让客户失望。那会是糟糕的一天。也可能是糟糕的一周。它可能会在荒郊野外抛锚。那会带来安全问题。
